blocks.text: 打造 Claude 最棒的部分之一，是一路上结下的友谊。我仍记得在几乎没人相信的时候，和 Sol 在办公室里讨论模型评估和 posttraining 的种种煎熬。他是我见过的唯一一位理解 scaling laws 的风投。

inlines.text: 打造 Claude 最棒的部分之一，是一路上结下的友谊。我仍记得在几乎没人相信的时候，和 Sol 在办公室里讨论模型评估和 posttraining 的种种煎熬。他是我见过的唯一一位理解 scaling laws 的风投。

blocks.text: 这些年来，他塑造了我对风投所能达到的最佳形态的整个看法：独立思考、戳穿废话，并在全世界反应过来之前很久就相信人。看着他带着同样的信念从零打造一支基金，令人深受鼓舞。这一切都是你应得的，我迫不及待想看到你打造一家世代级的公司。感谢你的友谊与指导。为在世界中一起打造更多东西干杯！

blocks.text: One of the best parts of building Claude was the friendships we made along the way. I still remember talking through model evals and posttraining hells with Sol in the office when few believed. He was the only VC I’ve met who understood scaling laws.

blocks.text: Over the years, he’s shaped my entire view of what venture can be at its best: thinking independently, cutting through the bs, and believing in people long before the world catches on. Watching him build a fund from scratch with those same convictions has been inspiring. You’ve earned every bit of it, and I can’t wait to see you build a generational firm. Thank you for your friendship and mentorship. Here’s to building many more things in the world!
